Dense mountain valley remains behind. Bright daytime cyan and emerald, minimal tasteful mystery. Open underwater center, angular dark rocks and soft sand.

4. Curving crescent canyon. A gigantic reverse waterfall curves upward like a sweeping ribbon along the RIGHT concave cliff into a high emerald pool. Nature dominates, ruins subtle and cozy, clear bright daytime and deep turquoise water; tiny floating droplets rise upward. Left hut and dock humble wood. Underwater scattered carved stones at edges and golden sand.
